prompts.music:
Create a theme variant of the FIRST reference image, which is an approved full-screen Flow Cabin close-up. FIRST reference controls camera, framing, perspective and ALL object positions and sizes. Keep every functional object's silhouette and screen/page/cover plane in the same source-pixel location as reference 1 so an app can reuse precise overlays. Do not pan, zoom, move objects or add more objects. SECOND reference gives the target room architecture/material/window scenery; IGNORE its whole-room isometric camera. THIRD reference gives target furniture materials/upholstery/hardware; IGNORE its grid and do not add unused furniture. Apply these references to make a distinctive but calm target-theme variant of this exact intimate composition, not a new composition. Full-bleed opaque 1536×1024 landscape, same crisp refined pixel-art scale. No transparent background, no floating room cutaway, no montage. No people, no pets, no text, numbers, clock hands, icons, letters, logos, signs or app UI. All record covers, instrument screens, task papers and notebook pages remain COMPLETELY BLANK cream surfaces. Even if an atlas contains decorative cover artwork or symbols, do not copy them onto these functional surfaces. Keep blank planes exactly aligned; preserve quiet negative space. Do not darken so much that the furniture is hard to read.

TARGET THEME: Moonlit writer's study. Deep desaturated navy-green painted wood and dark walnut, cool slate-blue velvet upholstery, ivory paper and antique brass. Pale blue-grey upper plaster, navy wainscot, elegant narrow arched detail in window frame but window opening stays in same bounds. A blue moonlit lake/forest outside, cool window light balanced with restrained warm indoor lamp glow. Readable serene midtones, no crushed-black shadow. If scene contains plant, graceful fern in same location.

Keep exactly two separate unobscured front-facing blank square album sleeves at left, hero turntable center, one speaker right, open blank lyric book lower right. No additional props.
